facts.text: The hotel is on Isla Verde Beach in the Isla Verde neighborhood of San Juan.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in the upscale neighborhood of Isla Verde, The Royal Sonesta San Juan is ideally situated on Isla Verde Beach

facts.text: Guests have direct access to the golden sands of Isla Verde Beach from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy direct access to the golden sands of Isla Verde Beach from our beachfront hotel.

facts.text: Isla Verde Beach has calm, swimmable waters along a long stretch of golden sand lined with shops and restaurants.
facts.excerpt: Isla Verde Beach offers calm, swimmable waters against a long stretch of golden sand beach lined with shops and restaurants.

facts.text: The hotel has a free-form lagoon-style pool with a swim-up bar.
facts.excerpt: Spend your days swimming and relaxing beside our free-form lagoon-style pool, complete with a swim-up bar.

facts.text: Zen Spa Brisas is an oceanfront spa where the sound of the waves accompanies the treatments.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in tranquility at our oceanfront spa, where the soothing sounds of the waves blend seamlessly with our expert treatments.

facts.text: Spa offerings include massages, body treatments, facials, relaxation lounges and a salon.
facts.excerpt:
- Massages
- Body Treatments
- Facials
- Relaxation lounges
- Salon

facts.text: The oceanfront fitness center is open 24/7 and has ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Stay active in our oceanfront fitness center, open 24/7, featuring state-of-the-art equipment and inspiring ocean views.

facts.text: Rooms and suites have ocean, garden, pool or city views.
facts.excerpt: The spacious rooms and suites offer stunning ocean, garden, pool and city views

facts.text: Room decor is inspired by the island's golden sands and turquoise waters.
facts.excerpt: surrounded by refined decor inspired by the island’s golden sands and turquoise waters

facts.text: The King Ocean View room has a private balcony overlooking the ocean.
facts.excerpt: The King Ocean View room features a private balcony overlooking the ocean

facts.text: Rooms have walk-in showers with rainforest shower heads.
facts.excerpt: Walk-In Shower with Rainforest Shower Head

facts.text: Room types include Club rooms, Club Suites and a Presidential Suite.
facts.excerpt:
- Club
- Club Suite
- Junior Suite
- Junior Executive Suite
- Presidential Suite

facts.text: Ocean Breeze serves Mediterranean-inspired cuisine and is described as Isla Verde's only beachfront dining destination.
facts.excerpt: Escape to Ocean Breeze, Isla Verde’s only beachfront dining destination. Enjoy Mediterranean-inspired cuisine

facts.text: Karaya Lobby Bar & Terrace serves locally inspired tapas and handcrafted cocktails with views of the lagoon pool and fire pits.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy locally inspired tapas, handcrafted cocktails, and breathtaking views of the lagoon pool amidst a backdrop of flickering fire pits.

facts.text: Sottovento Ristorante is an Italian fine-dining restaurant using locally sourced ingredients.
facts.excerpt: This fine-dining restaurant showcases the finest locally sourced ingredients

facts.text: La Plazoleta de Isla Verde, a plaza with local food, music and entertainment, is steps from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Isla Verde at La Plazoleta is a charming plaza just steps away from the resort.

facts.text: Old San Juan is 7 miles from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Located 7 miles away from the resort.

facts.text: Castillo San Felipe del Morro, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is 7.4 miles from the resort.
facts.excerpt: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, the majestic El Morro Fort is located 7.4 miles from our resort.

facts.text: The hotel offers expert-led guided tours of San Juan.
facts.excerpt: Experience the magic of San Juan with our expert-led tours.

facts.text: Room rates are subject to a daily resort fee of 22% plus taxes.
facts.excerpt: Room rates are subject to a daily Resort Fee of 22% (plus applicable taxes)

facts.text: The resort fee includes beachfront access with towels, beach chairs and umbrellas.
facts.excerpt: Beachfront access including towels & beach chairs/umbrellas

facts.text: The hotel is pet friendly.
facts.excerpt: Pet Friendly

facts.text: The resort hosts weddings at oceanfront venues with wedding planners.
facts.excerpt: Our stunning oceanfront venues and expert wedding planners will transform your dream wedding into a reality.

facts.text: The resort has a mascot called The Princess of San Juan.
facts.excerpt: Meet our charming mascot, The Princess of San Juan

facts.text: The hotel calls Isla Verde Beach one of the top beaches in Puerto Rico.
facts.excerpt: One of the top beaches in Puerto Rico

facts.text: Spa days of operation are stated inconsistently (open Thursday to Monday, but described as closed on Tuesdays).
facts.excerpt: open Thursday to Monday from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, with serene moments awaiting while the spa is closed on Tuesdays
